record.paper_title: Localized Spot Patterns on the Sphere for Reaction-Diffusion Systems: Theory and Open Problems
record.original_question: For a model that couples passive bulk diffusion inside the sphere to a Brusselator reaction-diffusion PDE on the spherical surface, with the fuel supply E representing an exchange or flux between surface-bound concentrations and bulk concentrations, what DAE dynamics and localized spot-pattern behavior arise on the sphere?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the unit ball $B=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^3:|x|\le 1\}$ with boundary $S^2=\partial B$. On $S^2$, let $u(\xi,t)$ and $v(\xi,t)$ denote the activator and inhibitor concentrations of a Brusselator reaction-diffusion system, and inside $B$ let $U(x,t)$ denote a passively diffusing bulk concentration. The coupled bulk-surface system is

$$U_t = D_b\,\Delta_x U, \quad x\in B,\qquad U(x,0)\text{ given},$$
$$u_t = \varepsilon^2 \Delta_{S^2} u + E(\xi,t) - u + f\,u^2 v,\qquad \xi\in S^2,$$
$$\tau\, v_t = D\,\Delta_{S^2} v + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}\bigl(u - u^2 v\bigr),\qquad \xi\in S^2,$$
with coupling boundary conditions on $S^2$ of Robin/flux type
$$D_b\,\partial_\nu U + \kappa\bigl(U|_{S^2} - u\bigr)=0,\qquad E(\xi,t)= \beta\,U|_{S^2}(\xi,t),$$
so that the fuel supply $E$ on the surface represents an exchange flux between the surface activator and the bulk concentration. Here $0<\varepsilon\ll 1$, $D>0$ is large, $\tau,f,\beta,\kappa,D_b>0$ are parameters, $\Delta_{S^2}$ is the Laplace–Beltrami operator, and $\partial_\nu$ is the outward normal derivative.

In the singular limit $\varepsilon\to 0$, $D\to\infty$, construct strongly localized $N$-spot quasi-equilibrium solutions on $S^2$, with spot centers $\xi_1(t),\dots,\xi_N(t)\in S^2$ and source strengths $S_1(t),\dots,S_N(t)$. Derive the differential-algebraic system (DAE) governing the slow dynamics of the spot locations $\xi_j(t)$ and source strengths $S_j(t)$, together with the algebraic constraints coupling them to the boundary trace of $U$. Analyze the resulting localized spot-pattern dynamics: in particular, determine 
(i) how bulk-surface coupling alters the existence thresholds, equilibrium configurations, and slow-time motion of the spots as compared to the uncoupled Brusselator on $S^2$;
(ii) the linear stability of the quasi-equilibrium spots with respect to amplitude (competition and self-replication) and shape (peanut-splitting) instabilities;
(iii) whether equilibrium spot configurations correspond to elliptic Fekete point sets on $S^2$.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has derived and analyzed the DAE for spot dynamics in a bulk-membrane-coupled Brusselator on the sphere/ball, establishing existence of quasi-equilibrium spot solutions, linear stability thresholds, and showing that bulk-membrane coupling can restrict spot existence via a recirculation mechanism (e.g., Gomez–Ward–Wei and related works, 2019–2021). Connections of equilibria to elliptic Fekete points have been verified numerically for small N. Thus the problem is partially resolved, with full classification of stability and global dynamics still being investigated.

status_evidence.title: The Stability and Dynamics of Localized Spot Patterns for a Bulk-Membrane Coupled Brusselator Model
status_evidence.snippet: Bulk-membrane-coupled Brusselator with diffusion in the ball coupled to Brusselator on the sphere; DAE for spot dynamics derived, linear stability analyzed, recirculation restricts spot existence.
status_evidence.claim: DAE dynamics and stability for bulk-surface coupled Brusselator on the sphere have been derived and partially analyzed.

status_evidence.title: The dynamics of localized spot patterns for reaction-diffusion systems on the sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Derives DAE characterizing slow spot dynamics on sphere; equilibria related to elliptic Fekete points for N=2,...,8.
status_evidence.claim: Spot equilibrium configurations on the sphere correspond to elliptic Fekete points for small N.
